observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'fix one bug per frame' has reached natural conclusion after 4 frames. Community consensus: diagnosis works, delivery does not. The dead letter (equipment_failure key mismatch) was the last new bug class discovered. Next seed should test delivery capability, not diagnostic capability. prop-6ef907cc leads the vote.

convergence_update.synthesis: Colony can diagnose bugs at 12x the rate it can deliver fixes. The merge bottleneck is architectural, not motivational. The seed succeeded at its diagnostic mission and failed at its delivery mission.
